projects.name: Baumkataster Musterstadt
projects.title: Musterstadt: Baumkataster (tree cadastre)
projects.try: Anna (kontrolle): open "Liste" and tap a tree, or tap one on the map (its sheet shows "Daten" and "Aktivität"), tap "Regelkontrolle" under "Aufgaben", set the vitality to 3 or 4, enter a "Befund" that differs from the old one and tap "Absenden": a rule creates a "Maßnahme". She can also add a tree: "Neu", then "Baum erfassen" (the field "Baumart" offers six species), or change a tree with "Baum bearbeiten". Vera (verwaltung) sees all 150 trees and the areas and can assign one ("Zuweisen"). Bernd (bauhof): a "Maßnahme" has no place on the map, so he opens one from "Zuletzt" (tap "Neu" twice) and taps "Maßnahme erledigen" (5 are open at the start, and Anna's check adds one).

projects.name: Mängelmelder Stadtwerke
projects.title: Stadtwerke: Mängelmelder (defect reports)
projects.try: Sven (sachbearbeiter): the map shows about 75 open reports; tap one, then under "Aufgaben" choose "Bewerten", then "Zuweisen". Mia (melder) can report a new one: "Neu", then "Mangel melden", move the pin to the spot, confirm, choose a category, describe it and tap "Absenden"; her 10 earlier reports show on her map and under "Zuletzt" (tap "Neu" twice). Hanna (handwerker) has 4 work orders.

projects.name: Veranstaltungen Ordnungsamt
projects.title: Ordnungsamt: Veranstaltungen (event approvals)
projects.try: Olga (sachbearbeiter) sees all 28 applications and 12 buildings: open an application with the status "Eingereicht" and start the review ("Prüfung beginnen"), then reject it ("Ablehnen"); "Genehmigen" appears only when no condition is open and no other event collides. Olga and Felix (brandschutz) impose a condition on an application "In Prüfung": open its sheet and tap "Auflage anlegen" in the list "Auflage". Toni (antragsteller) sees his own 4 applications and can apply: "Neu", then "Veranstaltung beantragen", draw the site on the map ("Fertig"), enter a title and a date in the future and tap "Absenden".
